SelectRows.trigger: the authored table becomes the selected journey source

Pivot.trigger: pivot categories into columns applied after two reshapes

PivotDirect.trigger: pivot categories into columns configured directly on the selected table

Preview.trigger: preview requested for the applied row definition

PreviewComplete.trigger: preview response accepted with rendered rows

PreviewError.trigger: preview response rejected or transport error

unmodeledEventPolicy.capability-read: The journey model does not own capability discovery.
unmodeledEventPolicy.semantic-inventory: The journey model does not own field inventory.
unmodeledEventPolicy.configured-column-context: The journey model does not own column context.
unmodeledEventPolicy.construction-capabilities: The journey model does not own reshape capability discovery.
unmodeledEventPolicy.reconcile: The journey model does not own draft reconciliation.
unmodeledEventPolicy.commands: Draft command persistence is below the row-definition journey boundary.
unmodeledEventPolicy.row-definition-choices: The journey model does not own row-choice inventory.
unmodeledEventPolicy.reload: Page reload is a lifecycle event outside the in-memory journey model.
